name: Wuxia
period: Not an era; literary/cinematic martial-hero genre
region: Must bind to a historical or fictional base setting
summary: Human-scale martial-hero storytelling overlay. It adds narrative/action grammar, not historical evidence.

weapons_tools.text: one or two physically traceable weapons; practical carry/sheath/contact logic

transportation.text: walking, horse, boat depending on base era

visual_arts.text: genre tension through stance, gaze, environment and implied story rather than magical particles

incompatible_or_anachronistic.text: using wuxia as a dynasty name
unmotivated xianxia magic in grounded wuxia

prompt_fragments.overlay: Add restrained martial narrative: alert weight distribution, believable hand-to-weapon relationship, travel-worn but era-compatible clothing, environmental story and tension. Keep action physically plausible unless a stronger fantasy overlay is explicit.

scope_note: Foundation pack: use as a bounded starting point, not an encyclopedia.
strict_reconstruction_note: A base era or explicit fictional world is mandatory.
